class.name: DualSenseManager
class.brief_description: Controls the DualSense controller. Like lightbar color, rumble, and custom trigger effects.
class.description: With this class you control the DualSense controller. Like lightbar color, rumble, and custom trigger effects.\n It handles device connection and disconnection, and provides signals for those events. You can also use it to test the various features of the controller.

method.name: set_rumble
method.description: Sets the rumble intensity for both triggers.

method.name: set_lightbar
method.description: Sets the color of the lightbar to new_color.

method.name: set_lightbar
method.description: Sets the color of the lightbar to new_color.

method.name: test_lightbar
method.description: This is a test method, it will apply the red color to the lightbar.

method.name: test_rumble
method.description: This is a test method, it will apply rumble to the controller at full intensity.

method.name: test_weapon
method.description: This is a test method, it will apply the weapon trigger effect to the right trigger.

signal.name: device_connected
signal.description: This signal is emitted when a DualSense controller is connected. The gamepad_id parameter indicates the ID of the connected controller.

signal.name: device_disconnected
signal.description: This signal is emitted when a DualSense controller is disconnected. The gamepad_id parameter indicates the ID of the disconnected controller.
